name: Mmalite Mmemme Kọmputa na Python
objectives: Site n'iji Google Colab na web browser, imeghe notebook, ide ma gbaa ahịrị print, na ịgụ ahịrị ikpeazụ nke ozi error, ebe mmemme ahụ na-agba ma e jiri ozi error dozie mperi ide ihe ọ bụla

Mgbe e nyere gị ozi mmemme chọrọ, ichekwa ya na variable nke ụdị ziri ezi, inweta input site n'aka onye ọrụ ma gosipụta ya site na f-string, na-agbanwe input ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ site na float() ma ọ bụ int() tupu ime mgbakọ

Mgbe e nyere gị iwu nwere ihe abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa nwere ike isi na ya pụta, ide ngọngọ if, elif na else na-ahọrọ ihe ziri ezi, nwere akara ntụnyere, colon na indentation ziri ezi, na-enye azịza ziri ezi maka uru nnwale ọ bụla
Mgbe e nyere gị ọtụtụ uru, ịmepụta list, ịgbakwunye otu ihe ma gụọ ihe site na index, na iji len() na sum() na ya, ebe index na azịza ọ bụla ziri ezi
Mgbe e nyere gị list ma ọ bụ ọrụ a ga-emeghachi, ide for loop nwere ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu na while loop na-akwụsị, ebe ngụkọta ziri ezi ma ọ dịghị loop na-agba ruo mgbe ebighị ebi

Mgbe e nyere gị obere nsogbu dị ka ilele budget, ide function nwere parameter na uru return, kpọọ ya na mmemme zuru ezu ma nwalee ya, ebe mmemme ahụ na-enye azịza ziri ezi maka opekata mpe input abụọ dị iche iche

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Imeghe Google Colab na ịgba ahịrị mbụ gị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Meghee notebook Colab, dee otu ahịrị Python ma gbaa ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji Google Colab na web browser, ị ga-enwe ike imeghe notebook, ide ma gbaa ahịrị print, na ịgụ ahịrị ikpeazụ nke ozi error, ebe mmemme ahụ na-agba ma e jiri ozi error dozie mperi ide ihe ọ bụla.
Mmemme (program) bụ ndepụta ntuziaka kọmputa na-agbaso n'usoro. Python bụ asụsụ mmemme: ụzọ isi dee ntuziaka ndị ahụ nke mmadụ nwere ike ịgụ. A na-eji ya maka weebụsaịtị, data, egwuregwu, robot na AI.
Google Colab bụ weebụsaịtị n'efu na-agba Python na browser gị. Ọ dịghị ihe ị ga-awụnye. A na-echekwa ọrụ gị dị ka notebook na Google Drive gị. Notebook nwere cell: igbe ebe ị na-ede koodu ma gbaa ya.
Ntuziaka mbụ gị bụ print. print("Hello, world!") na-egosi okwu dị n'ime akara ntinye okwu (quotes). Quotes ahụ na-agwa Python na nke a bụ ederede, ọ bụghị iwu. Ọ bụrụ na i mehie ide ihe, Python ga-egosi ozi error. Gụọ ahịrị ikpeazụ ya: ọ na-agwa gị ihe mebiri.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gaa na colab.research.google.com ma banye site n'akaụntụ Google.
- Họrọ ịmepụta notebook ọhụrụ.
- Pịa n'ime cell koodu mbụ ma dee: print("Hello, world!")
- Pịa bọtịnụ play dị n'akụkụ cell ahụ, ma ọ bụ Shift + Enter, iji gbaa ya.
- Gụọ ihe pụtara n'okpuru cell ahụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Mmemme (program): ndepụta ntuziaka kọmputa na-agbaso n'usoro.
- Python: asụsụ mmemme a ma ama nke dị mfe ịgụ.
- Notebook: faịlụ Colab nwere cell ebe ị na-ede ma gbaa koodu.
- Cell: otu igbe na notebook nwere koodu ị nwere ike ịgba.
- Ozi error: ihe Python na-egosi na ihe adịghị mma na koodu gị; ahịrị ikpeazụ na-ekwu ihe ọ bụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Google Colab: Ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị
Nwaa ugbu a: Meghee notebook Colab ọhụrụ. N'otu cell, print aha mbụ gị. Na cell nke abụọ, print otu ahịrịokwu banyere nri kacha amasị gị. Wee wepụ otu akara quote n'ebumnuche, gbaa ya, ma gụọ error ahụ. Tinyeghachi quote ahụ ma gbaa ya ọzọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike imeghe Google Colab, ide ahịrị print, ịgba ya, na ịgụ ozi error.

check.q: Na notebook Colab, gịnị bụ cell?
options: Igbe ebe ị na-ede koodu ma gbaa ya
check.why: Notebook nwere cell ebe ị na-ede ma gbaa koodu.

check.q: I dere prnt("Hi") Python wee gosi error ogologo. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Mechie Colab ma mepụta akaụntụ ọhụrụ
Leghara ya anya ma dekwuo koodu
Gụọ ahịrị ikpeazụ nke error ahụ, wee dozie nsụpe ya ka ọ bụrụ print
check.why: Ahịrị ikpeazụ nke error na-agwa gị ihe mebiri; ebe a, aha e dere ezighi ezi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Variable: inye data aha
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Chekwaa ozi na variable ma jụọ onye ọrụ input.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ozi mmemme chọrọ, ị ga-enwe ike ichekwa ya na variable nke ụdị ziri ezi, inweta input site n'aka onye ọrụ ma gosipụta ya site na f-string, na-agbanwe input ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ site na float() ma ọ bụ int() tupu ime mgbakọ.
Variable bụ aha na-ejide uru (value), dị ka igbe e dere aha n'elu ya. name = "Maya" na-etinye ederede Maya n'igbe a na-akpọ name. hours = 20 na-etinye ọnụọgụ 20 n'igbe a na-akpọ hours. Akara = pụtara "chekwaa nke a", ọ pụtaghị "ha nhata".
Uru nwere ụdị. Ederede dị n'ime quotes bụ string (str). Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu bụ integer (int). Ọnụọgụ nwere ntụpọ decimal bụ float (float). Ụdị dị mkpa: "5" + "5" na-enye "55", mana 5 + 5 na-enye 10.
input() na-arịọ onye na-agba mmemme ahụ ka o dee ihe. Ọ na-enyeghachi string mgbe niile, ya mere iji mee mgbakọ, ị ga-agbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ: hours = float(input("Hours worked: ")).
f-string na-agwakọta ederede na variable: print(f"Hi {name}, you worked {hours} hours.") Mkpụrụedemede f tupu quotes na brackets ndị gbagọrọ agbagọ (curly brackets) na-arụ ọrụ ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Họrọ aha variable dị mkpụmkpụ ma doo anya, na-enweghị oghere (jiri_underscore).
- Chekwaa uru site na =.
- Maka input onye ọrụ, jiri input("question: ").
- Tinye ya n'ime int() ma ọ bụ float() ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ọnụọgụ.
- Gosipụta azịza ahụ site na f-string.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Variable: aha na-ejide uru.
- String (str): ederede, e dere n'ime quotes.
- Integer (int): ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, dị ka 7.
- Float: ọnụọgụ nwere ntụpọ decimal, dị ka 7.5.
- input(): na-arịọ onye ọrụ ka o dee ihe ma nyeghachi ya dị ka string.
- f-string: ederede na-amalite na f nke nwere ike igosi variable n'ime { }.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee mmemme na-ajụ onye ọrụ aha ya, ụgwọ ọ na-akwụ kwa elekere, na elekere ole ọ rụrụ n'izu a. Chekwaa nke ọ bụla na variable, mụbaa ụgwọ ahụ na elekere ahụ, ma print: Hi <name>, you earned <amount> this week.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ichekwa uru na variable, ịjụ onye ọrụ input, ịgbanwe ederede ka ọ bụrụ ọnụọgụ, na igosipụta azịza doro anya.

check.why: Ọnụọgụ nwere ntụpọ decimal bụ float.

check.q: Ị chọrọ ka onye ọrụ dee ụgwọ elekere ya ka i wee mụbaa ya na elekere. Kedu ahịrị ị ga-ede?
check.why: input() na-enye string, ya mere float() na-eme ya ọnụọgụ i nwere ike iji mee mgbakọ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ime mkpebi site na if, elif na else
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Dee koodu na-eme ihe dị iche iche dabere na condition.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị iwu nwere ihe abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa nwere ike isi na ya pụta, ị ga-enwe ike ide ngọngọ if, elif na else na-ahọrọ ihe ziri ezi, nwere akara ntụnyere, colon na indentation ziri ezi, na-enye azịza ziri ezi maka uru nnwale ọ bụla.
Mmemme na-eme nhọrọ site na if. Condition bụ ajụjụ azịza ya bụ True ma ọ bụ False, dị ka hours > 40. Ọ bụrụ True, ahịrị ndị e debara n'ime (indented) n'okpuru ya ga-agba.
Akara ntụnyere: == ha nhata (akara nhata abụọ), != ha anaghị nhata, > karịrị, < erughị, >= opekata mpe, <= kacha. Ị nwere ike ijikọ condition site na and na or.
elif pụtara "else if": nlele nke abụọ mgbe nke mbụ bụ False. else na-agba mgbe ọ dịghị nlele ọ bụla bụ True. Indentation (oghere anọ) bụ otu Python si mara ahịrị ndị bụ nke if. Colab na-etinye ya maka gị mgbe colon gasịrị.
Ọmụmaatụ: if score >= 90: print("A") elif score >= 80: print("B") else: print("Keep practicing"). Akụkụ ọ bụla na-aga n'ahịrị nke ya, ebe e debara print n'ime.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee if, wee dee condition, wee dee colon.
- Debanye n'ime (indent) ahịrị ndị ga-agba mgbe ọ bụ True.
- Tinye elif maka nlele ọzọ ma ọ dị mkpa.
- Tinye else maka ihe ndị ọzọ niile.
- Nwalee ya na uru ga-eru alaka ọ bụla.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Condition: ajụjụ azịza ya bụ True ma ọ bụ False.
- Boolean: ụdị True ma ọ bụ False na Python.
- Indentation: oghere dị na mmalite ahịrị na-egosi ngọngọ ọ bụ nke ya.
- Alaka (branch): otu n'ime ụzọ if nwere ike ịgbaso.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee mmemme na-ajụ okpomọkụ na Fahrenheit. Ọ bụrụ 85 ma ọ bụ karịa, print "Hot: drink water." Ọ bụrụ 50 ma ọ bụ karịa, print "Nice day." Ma ọ bụghị ya, print "Bring a jacket." Gbaa ya ugboro atọ na 90, 50 na 30.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide ngọngọ if, elif na else ma nwalee alaka ọ bụla.

check.why: != pụtara ha anaghị nhata; == pụtara ha nhata.

check.q: Ị chọrọ print "Ticket free" ma ọ bụrụ na afọ (age) erughị 5 ma ọ bụ opekata mpe 65. Kedu condition ị ga-eji?
check.why: or na-eme ka condition bụrụ True mgbe otu akụkụ bụ True; ọ dịghị afọ erughị 5 ma ruo 65 n'otu oge.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Mmemme na-emeghachi ihe ma na-echeta ihe

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: List: idebe ọtụtụ uru ọnụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mepụta list, gbakwunye ihe na ya, ma gụọ ihe dị na ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọtụtụ uru, ị ga-enwe ike ịmepụta list, ịgbakwunye otu ihe ma gụọ ihe site na index, na iji len() na sum() na ya, ebe index na azịza ọ bụla ziri ezi.
List na-ejide ọtụtụ uru n'usoro, n'ime square brackets: prices = [3.50, 12.00, 6.25]. List nwekwara ike ijide ederede: chores = ["dishes", "laundry"].
Ihe ọ bụla nwere nọmba ọnọdụ a na-akpọ index. Python na-amalite ịgụ site na 0, ya mere prices[0] bụ ihe mbụ (3.50) ma prices[-1] bụ nke ikpeazụ.
Ngwa list bara uru: prices.append(4.99) na-agbakwunye ihe na njedebe. len(prices) na-agwa gị ọnụọgụ ihe dị na ya. sum(prices) na-agbakọ list ọnụọgụ. "dishes" in chores bụ True ma ọ bụrụ na ihe ahụ dị na list ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Mee list site na square brackets na comma.
- Gụọ ihe site na list_name[index], na-amalite na 0.
- Gbakwunye site na .append(value).
- Gụọ ọnụọgụ ihe site na len().
- Gbakọọ ọnụọgụ site na sum().
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- List: otu ìgwè uru n'usoro n'ime square brackets.
- Index: ọnọdụ ihe na list, na-amalite na 0.
- append: na-agbakwunye otu ihe na njedebe list.
- len(): na-enye ọnụọgụ ihe dị na ya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee list nke ihe atọ ị chọrọ ịzụta, ya na ọnụahịa ha na list nke abụọ. Gbakwunye otu ihe na ọnụahịa ọzọ. Print ọnụọgụ ihe dị ya, ihe mbụ, na ngụkọta ọnụahịa site na sum().
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịmepụta list, ịgụ ihe site na index, ịgbakwunye ihe, na ịgụ ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ ngụkọta ha.

check.why: Ihe ọ bụla nwere index, Python na-amalitekwa ịgụ site na 0.

check.q: chores = ["dishes", "laundry"]. Ị chọrọ ilele ma "laundry" dị na list ahụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-ede?
check.why: "laundry" in chores bụ True ma ọ bụrụ na ihe ahụ dị na list ahụ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Loop: imeghachi nzọụkwụ n'edeghachighị ha
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Jiri for loop gafee list na while loop iji meghachi ruo mgbe ọ gwụrụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị list ma ọ bụ ọrụ a ga-emeghachi, ị ga-enwe ike ide for loop nwere ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu na while loop na-akwụsị, ebe ngụkọta ziri ezi ma ọ dịghị loop na-agba ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
Loop na-emeghachi koodu. for loop na-agba otu ugboro maka ihe ọ bụla na list: for price in prices: print(price). Oge ọ bụla ọ gbara gburugburu, variable price na-ejide ihe na-esote.
range() na-eme list ọnụọgụ maka ịgụ: for i in range(5) na-agba ugboro ise ebe i = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
Ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu (running total) bụ usoro a na-ahụkarị: malite total = 0 tupu loop ahụ, wee gbakwunye total = total + price n'ime ya (ma ọ bụ total += price). Mgbe loop ahụ gwụrụ, total na-ejide ngụkọta ahụ.
while loop na-emeghachi ihe ma ọ bụrụhaala na condition bụ True, dịka ọmụmaatụ while answer != "done". Hụ na ihe dị n'ime loop ahụ na-agbanwe condition ahụ, ma ọ bụghị ya ọ ga-agba ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. Na Colab, pịa bọtịnụ stop iji kwụsị loop na-anaghị akwụsị.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kpebie ihe na-emeghachi.
- Maka ihe ọ bụla na list, jiri: for item in my_list:
- Debanye n'ime (indent) koodu na-emeghachi.
- Maka ngụkọta, tọọ total = 0 tupu loop ahụ ma gbakwunye n'ime ya.
- Maka while loop, hụ na condition ahụ nwere ike ịghọ False.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Loop: koodu na-emeghachi.
- for loop: na-emeghachi otu ugboro maka ihe ọ bụla na list ma ọ bụ range.
- while loop: na-emeghachi ma ọ bụrụhaala na condition bụ True.
- range(): na-eme usoro ọnụọgụ, na-amalite na 0 ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ e kwuru.
- Ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu (running total): variable ị na-agbakwunye ihe n'ime loop.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee while loop na-anọgide na-ajụ "Add a price (or type done): ". Gbakwunye ọnụọgụ ọ bụla na list. Mgbe onye ọrụ dere done, jiri for loop na ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu gbakọọ ọnụahịa ndị ahụ ma print ngụkọta ahụ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike imeghachi koodu site na for na while loop ma debe ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu.

check.why: range(4) na-amalite ịgụ na 0 ma kwụsị tupu 4.

check.q: Loop gị na-agbakọ ọnụahịa mana total na-alaghachi na 0 oge ọ bụla. Ebee ka ị ga-ebuga total = 0?
check.why: Tọọ total = 0 otu ugboro tupu loop ahụ, wee gbakwunye na ya n'ime.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Function: ịchịkọta koodu ị nwere ike iji ọzọ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Dee function nwere input na uru return, wee jiri ya na mmemme zuru ezu.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị obere nsogbu dị ka ilele budget, ị ga-enwe ike ide function nwere parameter na uru return, kpọọ ya na mmemme zuru ezu ma nwalee ya, ebe mmemme ahụ na-enye azịza ziri ezi maka opekata mpe input abụọ dị iche iche.
Function bụ ngọngọ koodu nwere aha ị nwere ike ịgba mgbe ọ bụla ị chọrọ ya. I jirila ndị dị na Python: print(), len(), sum(). Ugbu a ị ga-ede nke gị site na def.
def check_budget(prices, budget): na-amalite function nwere parameter abụọ, input ndị ọ chọrọ. N'ime ya, ị na-arụ ọrụ ahụ. return na-ezighachi azịza nye onye kpọrọ ya.
Ịkpọ function na-agba ya: result = check_budget([3.5, 12, 6.25], 25). Ezigbo function na-arụ otu ọrụ ma nwee aha na-ekwu ọrụ ahụ ọ bụ.
Ịchịkọta ya ọnụ: ọrụ ikpeazụ na-eji ihe niile dị n'ihe ọmụmụ a. Buru ụzọ hazie ya n'okwu dị mfe (nweta budget, gbakọọ ọnụahịa, tụnyere, print), wee mee ahịrị ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ koodu ma nwalee ya na budget abụọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee atụmatụ ahụ n'okwu dị mfe dị ka comment na-amalite na #.
- Malite function ahụ site na def name(parameters):
- Debanye ahụ ya n'ime (indent); jiri loop na if n'ime ya.
- Jiri return zighachi azịza, ma ọ bụ print n'ime ya.
- Kpọọ function ahụ ma nwalee ya na input dị iche iche.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Function: ngọngọ koodu nwere aha ị nwere ike ịgba ugboro ugboro.
- def: okwu na-amalite function ọhụrụ.
- Parameter: input function chọrọ, e dere aha ya n'ime brackets ya.
- return: na-ezighachi uru site na function.
- Comment: ndetu na koodu na-amalite na #; Python na-eleghara ya anya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: dee check_budget(prices, budget). N'ime ya, jiri loop gbakọọ ọnụahịa, wee print total na "Under budget by X" ma ọ bụ "Over budget by X". Jụọ onye ọrụ budget site na float(input()), kpọọ function ahụ na list ịzụ ahịa gị, ma nwalee ya na budget dị elu na nke dị ala.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide ma kpọọ function nke gị, ma jikọta variable, input, if, list na loop n'otu mmemme na-arụ ọrụ.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Function Ọ dịghị function, ma ọ bụ ọ naghị anara ọnụahịa na budget. Function nwere parameter maka ọnụahịa na budget nke na-eweghachi (return) ma ọ bụ na-egosipụta azịza ahụ. Function ahụ nwere aha doro anya, na-arụ otu ọrụ ma na-eji return. Loop na ngụkọta Ngụkọta ahụ ezighi ezi ma ọ bụ e jighị loop. for loop na-agbakọ ọnụahịa n'ime ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu nke malitere na 0. Ọ na-egosipụtakwa ọnụọgụ ihe e lelere site na len(). Mkpebi Mmemme ahụ anaghị ekwu Under budget ma ọ bụ Over budget, ma ọ bụ na-ekwu nke na-ezighi ezi. if na else na-egosipụta ozi ziri ezi ya na ọdịiche ya. Ọ na-ejikwa elif edozi mgbe ọ ha nhata budget kpọmkwem. Input A jụghị budget, ma ọ bụ e jiri ya dị ka ederede nke mere mgbakọ ahụ ji daa. input() na-ajụ budget ma float() na-eme ya ọnụọgụ. Ọ na-egosipụta azịza ahụ site na f-string dị mfe ịgụ. Nnwale E gbara mmemme ahụ otu ugboro ma ọ bụ e gbaghị ya ma ọlị. E gbara ya na budget abụọ dị iche iche, azịza abụọ ahụ ziri ezi. E nwalekwara ya na budget ha nhata ngụkọta kpọmkwem, ma ọ bụ na list tọgbọrọ chakoo. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.
